name: @lattice/example-terraces
description: TERRACES — a gallery exhibit. A hillside of stepped fields, and why picking must be terrain-aware.
$comment: Five of nine. @lattice/iso is the row — `height`, `hittest` and the camera are the whole exhibit. @lattice/sim has no economy here and @lattice/persist has nothing that may outlive the tab, per docs/GALLERY.md. @lattice/audio is absent for the same reason island's is: a page that makes noise before it is touched is worse than a silent one, and the gallery still has no shared answer for the unlock gesture. @lattice/input arrives through the shared bootstrap, and — see README, kit finding 1 — is also the package this exhibit had to reach around, because it resolves every action's tile on flat ground.
